purpose: Record SI-canonical forecasts before their outcomes, score actual outcomes, and explain model accuracy, calibration, baseline-relative skill, drift, provenance and limitations.
primaryGoal: Determine which models deserve trust and inspect or score the underlying predictions without confusing missing measurements with zero.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Error, bias, coverage and skill cells each implement local threshold-to-color branches while domain grade presentation already uses VerdictBadge. The thresholds are specialist business semantics, not grounds for a new universal status engine.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep thresholds and textual values; reuse semantic token styling or a small domain-local cell helper only if genuinely repeated. Do not merge different scoring meanings.

responsive.status: source-inspected; runtime and all viewports unverified
responsive.existing: Forecast form uses md two-column/xl four-column reflow; scoring form uses md three-column layout; EvidencePanel uses lg three-column reflow. Panels retain min-w-0. Chart height is 280.

findings.detail: Scorecards retain only model, grade and MAPE below md; ledger at line 798 retains only model, error and when. DataTable.tsx:715-725 applies hidden md:table-cell to other cells. Neither caller supplies mobilePresentation or a detail fallback. Calibration inspection and Score it actions, predicted/observed values, intervals, horizon and many scorecard metrics are therefore hidden by the source CSS branch. Actual mounted behavior remains unverified.
findings.fix: Use existing DataTable mobilePresentation/full-detail mechanism to retain every column and action on narrow containers; do not simply remove metadata or build a second table pipeline. Retain stable table IDs and loaded-row semantics.

findings.detail: Scoring submit and cancel share a non-wrapping flex row. Long translations and enlarged text may overflow the smallest allocated widths; this is a source risk, not a measured failure.
findings.fix: Permit wrapping/stacking while preserving visible action order and comfortable target size; verify 320px, long translations and 200% text.

accessibility.status: source-inspected; keyboard, focus, contrast, touch and screen-reader behavior unverified

findings.rule: MDC-040: important state must not depend only on decoration
findings.detail: Drift status is represented by aria-hidden directional icons and color; the adjacent caption exposes only the drift ratio. The source drift_status meaning (improving/degrading/stable) is not announced here.
findings.fix: Add localized visible or assistive text for the actual returned drift_status while preserving the ratio, icon and thresholds.

states.loading: OwnershipPanel derives loading with no data and keeps card shells; portfolio preserveSummary retains unknown-aware brief. Query source also reaches PageLayout.
states.empty: Scorecards, calibration and ledger have localized reason-specific empty messages. Portfolio preserves summary. EvidencePanel separately describes absent quality/evidence/limitations.
states.error: OwnershipPanel routes fatal source error and retry through SourceContent. Each mutation has MutationError inside its editor and hook-owned error toast.
states.retained: OwnershipPanel uses retained state for stale source with data; editors are explicitly kept reachable on initial read failure. OwnershipBrief distinguishes source failure, retained source, refresh and unknown freshness.
states.offline: No separate page-level offline source or network check is present. Whether shared trust presentation exposes disconnected state is not proved by the bounded reads.
states.unknownVersusZero: Summary raw values remain undefined/null rather than fabricated zero; zero observed outcomes are checked with != null and remain measured values. Empty arrays are not presented as scored models.

findings.detail: outcomeFor, outcomeDraft and forecast draft live independently of selected vehicle. Score it stores only prediction ID at line 273; submitOutcome at lines 160-171 does not compare the current vehicle to the selected prediction. A workspace vehicle change can leave a scoring form targeting the previous vehicle's prediction or silently reuse a forecast draft for the new vehicle. Page-local source does not show a scope reset or ownership label.
findings.fix: Bind editor identity to captured vehicle/prediction context and explicitly close, guard or confirm context changes without silently losing unsaved input. Preserve retained-data refresh behavior within the same scope.

visualIssues.detail: Calibration bars hardcode cyan rgba(34,211,238,0.65) and amber rgba(251,191,36,0.5) at lines 596 and 603 instead of the existing chart palette. Local fill choices bypass theme/chart preference ownership.
visualIssues.fix: Use the current restrained chart palette for the same error and signed bias series; retain legend identity, data meaning and user choices. Do not invent another palette.

visualIssues.detail: Scoring form uses border-white/[0.07] and bg-white/[0.02]. EvidencePanel.tsx likewise uses fixed-white source cards. These are source-confirmed token bypasses, not measured contrast failures.
visualIssues.fix: Compose existing neutral surface/border tokens through current layout/form primitives; keep form grouping, provenance cards and all evidence text.

visualIssues.detail: Trust score caption sets text-xs directly while nearby content already uses Text variant=caption.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse Text/Caption with tabular-nums and existing muted role; preserve score precision and /100 suffix.

architectureIssues.detail: This dated analysis owns local windowDays (90 default) and a page Analysis window Select at lines 435-444. It does not consume useRangeState. workspaceScope.ts:23-77 excludes /ownership/model-trust from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS, so header range control is not currently available. Hook accepts only window_days; custom bounds and server filtering equivalence are not established.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must determine and support the actual analysis-window contract before moving scope to header View settings: retain existing 30/60/90/180/365 choices and defaults, support both instant bounds if appropriate, preserve scoring-window semantics and register the exact route. Do not locally fake custom-range filtering.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-033/MDC-045: preserve source measurements until display formatting
architectureIssues.detail: Calibration mean_abs_error and mean_bias are converted through toFixed(3) before reaching both the chart and ChartContainer data table. Very small SI-domain errors can become literal zero. This is not merely number-label formatting; input series values are rounded.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep source numeric errors/biases in chart and export data and apply existing scientific formatting at labels/table/tooltip boundaries. Treat this as a targeted accuracy correction, not permission to alter backend scoring or units.

architectureIssues.detail: Chart accessible columns and Y axis describe mean absolute error/bias without selectedCard.si_unit. RMSE cell at line 358 also lacks a unit; SI unit is available in the model/target column. This makes standalone chart/table interpretation ambiguous across heterogeneous targets.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain canonical SI values and expose the selected model's exact source unit in axis/table/accessible/export context. Do not guess currencies or reinterpret minor-unit predictions.

architectureIssues.detail: Several columns declare sortable:true, but neither DataTable invocation at lines 528-534 or 796-802 supplies onSort, sortKey or sorted data. DataTable.tsx:1424 and 1557 gate sort controls on onSort. Source promises of sortable columns therefore do not establish usable sorting.
architectureIssues.fix: Either wire existing useTableSort with actual field accessors and current source order, or accurately mark unsupported sorting; preserve actions and export behavior. Do not create a parallel sorting implementation.

priority.reason: Mobile source CSS hides core inspect/scoring actions and forecast values. Scope-bound drafts and rounding are trust-sensitive preservation risks; workspace range integration requires an explicit owner. Most existing domain/shared architecture should be retained rather than rewritten.

sections.name: Scored against reality, not against itself

actions: Choose 30/60/90/180/365-day analysis window; initial page default 90 days
Inspect scorecard calibration; fallback to first returned card
Toggle forecast editor; submit forecast or cancel
Select target and derived canonical SI unit from the existing 20-entry map
Score an unobserved prediction; submit actual value or cancel; never offer scoring on measured zero/already observed row
Retry source failures through current source recovery
Current shared summary detail review, table capabilities and chart toolbar/accessible-data capabilities must remain; their complete mounted inventory is unverified
Hide/show calibration series using model-trust-calibration persistence identity
dataBehavior: Keep every portfolio metric: score /100, trusted/watch/unreliable counts and scored/recorded denominator; unknown is not zero.
Keep all scorecard values: model, target/unit, grade/score, scored/pending, MAPE, median APE, bias, RMSE, interval coverage, skill versus naive, drift ratio/status and calibration action.
Keep ledger model/target/unit, predicted and optional interval bounds, observed/pending, percent error, interval membership, horizon, predicted date and scoring/observed timestamp.
Keep calibration bins, error/bias series, samples, accessible table, narrative, first/last scoring dates and persistent legend state; precision issue is separately reported.
Keep source evidence, quality counts/coverage/window/reasons, limitations and explicit non-capabilities: no retraining and no causal drift explanation.
Keep SI target/unit map and seconds horizon serialization; cost_minor values remain minor units with no invented currency.
Keep query key, vehicle enablement, abort signal, ownership invalidation, existing write endpoints/toasts and retained-data editor behavior.
Preserve table IDs ownership-trust-scorecards and ownership-trust-predictions and chartKey model-trust-calibration.
